sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of proceeds The Warrants and Warrant Shares to be offered and sold using this prospectus will be offered and sold by the Selling Stockholder named in this prospectus. Accordingly, we will not receive any proceeds from any sale of Warrants or Warrant Shares of our Common Stock in this offering. See “ Use of Proceeds .” National Securities Exchange Listing Our Common Stock is listed on The Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “GPRO.” There is currently no public market for the Warrants. We do not intend to apply for listing of the Warrants on a national securities exchange or over the counter market.
